implemented_features: Server-side endpoint /api/studio/catalog loads data/ownership.yaml + data/upstream-capabilities.yaml from a controlled path (process.cwd()/data/). NO user input for the file path. NO secrets, NO env vars, NO arbitrary filesystem access.

studio/catalog.ts utility: loadCatalog() parses both YAML files, validates required fields (domain/id + canonical_owner), detects duplicates, records errors for malformed/missing entries. determineStatus() maps capability keys to DOCUMENTED or INTEGRATED based on the INTEGRATED_EVIDENCE map (hardcoded from actual source inspection at pinned SHA). NEVER returns RUNTIME_VERIFIED.

INTEGRATED_EVIDENCE map: 16 capabilities verified as wired into engine source code (goal-compiler → src/goal/goal-compiler.ts; organization-planner → src/organization/organization-planner.ts; genome-compiler → src/genome/genome-compiler.ts; cognitive-resource-router → src/routing/; external-agent-interop → src/gateway/a2a-server.ts; agent-ui-lifecycle → src/agui/event-bridge.ts; tools-resources → src/runtime/mcp/capability-provider.ts; computer-container → src/runtime/openbot/adapter.ts; etc.).

StudioCatalog component: searchable (name/domain/owner/decision/notes/evidence/upstream), filterable (owner/status/source), grid of capability cards. Each card shows: name, owner, domain, source, evidence, status badge (DOCUMENTED/INTEGRATED/RUNTIME_VERIFIED with NON-color-only cues), upstream project, upstream status, future value, decision, satisfies, notes, upstream reference link (rel=noopener noreferrer nofollow).

Status mapping (req #2): DOCUMENTED = appears in YAML only. INTEGRATED = verified source-code wiring (from INTEGRATED_EVIDENCE map). RUNTIME_VERIFIED = NEVER claimed (requires actual runtime probing, out of scope for controlled environment). Summary stats show runtime_verified=0 honestly.

Honest notices: 'Documentation only — not runtime discovery' banner (gateway has no /capabilities endpoint in v1). 'No Install / Connect / Enable / Execute actions — read-only' (req #5, #6). Parsing errors surface as a collapsible details panel.
NO second capability registry or plugin manager (req #6). The catalog is purely a read-only viewer over the YAML files.

15 unit tests covering: INTEGRATED status for source-wired capabilities, DOCUMENTED for YAML-only, NEVER RUNTIME_VERIFIED (critical), real catalog loads, required fields, status counts, malformed YAML, missing fields, duplicate records, unavailable sources, missing owner, no YAML→INTEGRATED promotion, total count, INTEGRATED evidence. All 15/15 PASS.

tests.actual: PASS — No Install/Connect/Enable/Execute buttons anywhere in the StudioCatalog component. All capabilities show status badge (DOCUMENTED or INTEGRATED). RUNTIME_VERIFIED is never shown (count=0 in summary stats). Honest 'Documentation only' notice is permanent.

open_findings.description: INTEGRATED_EVIDENCE map is hardcoded based on source inspection at pinned SHA bff7b0a. If the engine source changes (e.g., a capability is unwired), the map would become stale. A future improvement would verify INTEGRATED status dynamically by actually checking the source files at runtime — but that would require arbitrary filesystem access (which req #7 forbids).
open_findings.action: Documented. The map is version-controlled alongside the UI; updates require a new commit.

open_findings.description: The data/ YAML files are copied into web/data/ for the Next.js project. They are duplicates of agentcraft/repo/data/. If the engine repo's YAML files change, the copies must be updated manually.
open_findings.action: Future: symlink or build-time copy. For now, documented as a manual sync step.

known_limitations: No /capabilities gateway endpoint exists in v1. The catalog is loaded from controlled data/ YAML files only.
Statuses are DOCUMENTED (YAML only) or INTEGRATED (verified source wiring). RUNTIME_VERIFIED requires actual runtime probing and is NEVER claimed.
INTEGRATED_EVIDENCE map is hardcoded from source inspection at pinned SHA bff7b0a. Updates require a new commit.
The data/ YAML files are copied into web/data/ (manual sync with agentcraft/repo/data/).
No second capability registry or plugin manager built inside the UI (req #6).
Controlled server-side path: the endpoint reads from process.cwd()/data/ only. NO arbitrary filesystem access, NO secrets, NO env vars (req #7).
